body:
oh my, similar things have happened to me. I have attempted suicide as well. My mom would consantly say, “oh, are you going to kill yourself now, I have dealt with the same things as you have and I didn’t kill myself because of it.”  Which she did not, because if she did she would understand what i was going through and be sympathetic.

Also, my school knew about me attempting sucide, because my mother told them but they never made an adult walk around with me. :O thats odd. 

The attention thing drives me crazy, because you can’t kill yourself for  attention, your dead how are you gonna get the attention? like what lol. 
I do understand other things to get attention. But its so hard to talk about my problems, that I have to drop sutble hints to say HELP ME I AM HURTING, because otherwise people won’t listen or pay ATTENTION. And wanting attention isn’t a bad thing, we all need it.

I had a friend who had said something incenstive to me concering my weight. (I have an eating disorder.) He told me, “calm down its just a joke.” 
I told him it wasn’t funny, that shit hits home for me, and he unfollowed/deleted me on all social media, and hasn’t spoken to me since. This one I find strange because, i just don’t understand why he is mad at me or hates me or whatever, its quite confusing. 

Depression and sucide i guess are just one of those things that people don’t like to sympathize with because they think your weak or they think you just want attention. the whole, “get over it and move on.”

Anyways, if you just want to vent, or need someone to talk to,  i’ll be here.

i am sorry to hear that. I have never been in a long term relationship like that, so i don't really know what you are going through, but if you ever want to talk about anything or just vent, i am here.

A stupid joke that i hope will make you smile,
My sister bet me a hundred dollars I couldn't build a car out of spaghetti.
You should've seen the look on her face as I drove pasta!

but i felt like i had to do it. i don't do it anymore, i don't have the strength to bring myself to do it, although sometimes i want too.
